headline: As of 2026-10-25: 27,052,582 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 47 of 50 states, D+11.5 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 27,052,582 early/mail ballots cast so far across 47 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+11.5 by registration.
Most ballots cast: Texas (4,066,553), California (2,758,100), Florida (2,602,979).
